(()=>{const d=__ds; d.G.god=true; d.G.toSpawn=0; for(const z of d.zombies) z.dead=true; d.sim(0.1); const T=d.vm.constructor; const g=d.vmGunNow(); d.vm.updateMatrixWorld(true); d.vmCam.updateMatrixWorld(true); let mn=[9,9],mx=[-9,-9], n=0; const v=new (d.camera.position.constructor)(); g.group.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh) return; const pa=o.geometry.attributes.position; for(let i=0;i<pa.count;i+=1){v.fromBufferAttribute(pa,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld).project(d.vmCam); mn[0]=Math.min(mn[0],v.x); mn[1]=Math.min(mn[1],v.y); mx[0]=Math.max(mx[0],v.x); mx[1]=Math.max(mx[1],v.y); n++;} }); const w=(mx[0]-mn[0])*innerWidth/2, h=(mx[1]-mn[1])*innerHeight/2; return {aspect:+d.vmCam.aspect.toFixed(2), mnY:+mn[1].toFixed(2), mxY:+mx[1].toFixed(2), gun:d.P.guns[d.P.cur].key, verts:n, screenW:Math.round(w), screenH:Math.round(h), vmPos:d.vm.position.toArray().map(x=>+x.toFixed(3)), vmRot:[d.vm.rotation.x,d.vm.rotation.y,d.vm.rotation.z].map(x=>+x.toFixed(3))}})()

(()=>{const d=__ds; let mesh=0, tris=0; const c=d.WD.car.group; c.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){mesh++; const g=o.geometry; tris+=(g.index?g.index.count:g.attributes.position.count)/3; for(const v of g.attributes.position.array) if(!isFinite(v)) throw 'NaN';}}); c.updateMatrixWorld(true); const bb=new (d.camera.position.constructor)(); const box={min:[9e9,9e9,9e9],max:[-9e9,-9e9,-9e9]}; c.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh)return; const pa=o.geometry.attributes.position; for(let i=0;i<pa.count;i++){bb.fromBufferAttribute(pa,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld).sub(c.position); for(let k=0;k<3;k++){box.min[k]=Math.min(box.min[k],bb.getComponent(k)); box.max[k]=Math.max(box.max[k],bb.getComponent(k));}}}); return {meshes:mesh, tris:Math.round(tris), size:box.max.map((v,k)=>+(v-box.min[k]).toFixed(2))}})()
